findings: The silhouette is taller and the city is denser, but the massing now reads as a forest of identical spires instead of an orthogonal lava labyrinth.
The keep remains a generic stacked tower with oversized emissive slabs.
The maze is mostly lost in oblique views and the lava canal network is not visible enough to define navigation.
The crater terraces remain broad empty rings rather than a city fused into volcanic cliffs.
The front-cliff view proves closed depth but still fails source identity and heat-lit readability.
retirement_rule: One naked blockout plus one bounded correction was consumed without reaching the 0.75 continuation floor. No material polish, animation work, or runtime integration is allowed for this representation.
